title: St Peters Anglican Primary School
description: stpeters.sa.edu.au St Peter's Anglican Grammar independent Anglican co-ed school in Campbelltown, NSW (est. 1983, revived parish school), teaching Pre-K to Year 6 (~428 students, ICSEA 1118 — 89th percentile nationally). It's part of the Campbelltown Anglican Schools Council (CASC) alongside Broughton Anglican College (P–12) and St Peter's Heart (special needs). Academics are solid: NAPLAN scores run ~33 points above the national average, SchoolRank rates it 69.3/100 ("Good", 129th in NSW), and it's one of only two IB PYP World Schools in the Macarthur region. Fees are modest — $9,400/yr (K–2) and $9,920/yr (Y3–6) — with generous sibling discounts up to 100%. Led by Principal Michelle McDonnell (2023–) under CEO Andrew Middleton; 39 teachers, 14.9:1 ratio, strong specialist programs (German, French, STEAM from K). The one major controversy: in July 2022 the council abruptly closed a just-launched high school (Years 7–12)
